title: Experiment manifest (a research project file, schema ember-research/1)
description: The `.ember` file of Studio's Research tab: UTF-8 JSON, one object. It is an index: it names the question, the hypotheses, the models and the experiments (each with a frozen spec and bar) and holds no results. Studio always writes every member listed as required. Studio opens a file that carries other members and drops them at the next save, so this schema refuses them: a file that passes is one Studio would write back unchanged.

created_utc.description: When the file was made, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

receipts.description: Empty when the file is made; a list of text entries.

paper.description: Optional. The project's paper: the LaTeX source the Research tab builds and shows as pages. Left out when the project has no paper.

sha256_or_empty.description: A lowercase sha256, or the empty text when it was not taken (Studio leaves a model's sha256 empty; a spec or bar's is empty when the file could not be read at the moment it was added).

id.description: H1, H2, ... (the next free one when added).
e1, e2, ... (the next free one when added); never repeats in a file.

spec_path.description: The frozen spec, written with forward slashes.

bar_path.description: The frozen bar, written with forward slashes. It may end `#<heading>` to name one `## <heading>` section of a spec.
